verdict.rationale: SumUp documents a broad public API covering checkouts, refunds, merchant profile and transaction queries, reader pairing and payments via Cloud API, and API-key/OAuth access. It also publishes an OpenAPI spec and a managed MCP server for agents. Nothing claims or shows parity with the UI: back-office features such as invoicing, payment links, reporting, multi-store management, rewards and marketing are not shown to be reachable via API, and webhooks cover only checkout status changes. Missing for 10: explicit API–UI parity statement, API coverage of invoicing/payment links/reporting/back-office/POS features, broader event coverage, independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
